scientific_integrity: The entropy, coded support, maximal-entropy uniqueness, and topological nonmixing are from Reyes (2026); general coded-shift Bernoulli modulo periodicity is credited to earlier literature. The specific phase laws, long-lag covariance constants, coboundary, and residue-class limit laws are established analytically in the attached proof. Finite checks supplement rather than replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the unique maximal-entropy measure of the binary frequency shifts Sigma(k/(k+1)), integer k>=1; the phase-resolved formulas are for stationary orbit statistics. Transfer function is unbounded but has all finite moments. No priority claim to general Bernoulli renewal or coded-shift uniqueness. Independent audit not performed.
title: Periodic equilibrium correlations and tight digit counts in rational frequency shifts
